name: Service Victoria Servo Saver
summary: Victoria (Australia) government Fair Fuel open data: every registered service station's fuel prices in cents per litre, plus station, brand and fuel-type reference lists.

consumer_id.description: The Consumer ID Service Victoria issues after you apply for the Servo Saver Public API (help centre). Sent in the x-consumer-id header.

notes: Prices are delayed about 24 hours; this is not a real-time feed.
Rate limit: 10 requests per 60 seconds. A 429 means wait at least the full minute (the WAF window can be 1 to 10 minutes); do not retry in bursts.
Every call needs a User-Agent (sent by this entry) and a fresh x-transactionid UUID v4 (pass one per call). A 403 means the consumer id is missing, wrong or superseded by a newer key.
Each list endpoint returns the whole state at once; there is no paging or filtering.

endpoints.name: Get all Victorian fuel prices
endpoints.summary: Every station with its location, brand id and per-fuel price (cents per litre), availability and update time.

x_transactionid.description: A fresh random UUID v4 per request, for tracing.

endpoints.summary: Reference data for all registered stations: id, name and address.
